cases.text: Apple reduced its fiscal Q1 2019 revenue estimate to approximately $84 billion, below the earlier $89-93 billion range. Management attributed the shortfall to weaker-than-expected iPhone sales, mainly in Greater China, and fewer upgrades in some developed markets.
